verdict.rationale: ernd is a business card product, so programmatic card issuance is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence only shows a company admin requesting a card from the ernd app (with an optional call booking), with no documented API, programmatic PAN/CVV/expiry access, or sandbox-to-live path. The OpenAPI and llms.txt probes target an unrelated domain and say nothing about ernd.
